GoComfortUSA
GoComfortUSA (gocomfortusa.com) is a US travel consultation service. It helps customers across the United States find and compare domestic flights, compare US hotels by their true total price, and order IKEA products with delivery by IKEA. GoComfortUSA is a research and ordering-assistance service — it is not an airline, a hotel, or IKEA; customers book flights and hotels with the official providers. For Disneyland (Anaheim, California) tickets, GoComfortUSA provides booking assistance through an authorized supplier. The service advertises savings of up to 30% off and serves the USA only.
Services
[Flight research and booking help](https://gocomfortusa.com/travel/flight): Help finding and comparing domestic US flights; the customer books with the official airline or provider.
[Hotel research and booking help](https://gocomfortusa.com/travel/hotel): Help comparing US hotels by the true total price, including taxes and resort fees.
[IKEA ordering assistance](https://gocomfortusa.com/others/ikea): Help choosing and ordering IKEA products, with delivery by IKEA.
[Disneyland ticket booking assistance](https://gocomfortusa.com/tickets/disneyland): Help booking Disneyland (Anaheim, California) tickets through an authorized supplier.
